innerText fixture

This page collects the cases the jsdom harness cannot see. Each item states what the extracted text should be. If a translation box shows something else, the innerText path is wrong.

1. Hidden text must not be collected

The retention window has already been shortenedSHOULD_NOT_APPEAR for every shard in the stream.
A snapshot was written to durable storageALSO_HIDDEN before the change took effect.

기대 : SHOULD_NOT_APPEAR · ALSO_HIDDEN 이 번역문에 없어야 한다

2. Line breaks become newlines, not glue

The first line ends here
and the second line starts here without glue.
A paragraph break follows this sentence

and another block begins afterwards.

기대 : "here and the second" 처럼 띄어져야 한다. "hereand" 면 틀렸다

3. Script and style content must not leak

The cluster was resized before the query ran and the plan changed.
The crawler runs nightly and updates the catalog each time.

기대 : SCRIPT_LEAK · color:red 가 번역문에 없어야 한다

4. Whitespace is normalized

This option has irregular spacing spread across several source lines.
Tabs and newlines surround this option in the source markup.

기대 : 공백이 하나로 합쳐져야 한다. 원문 그대로면 틀렸다

5. Nested elements read in order

The partition key determines which shard receives each record.
Three levels of nesting still read as one sentence here.

기대 : 조각이 순서대로 이어져 한 문장이 되어야 한다

6. Native radios with the same quirks

Which change addresses the cause?

기대 : NATIVE_HIDDEN 이 없고 br 자리가 띄어져야 한다

7. Body text for the fallback layer

This paragraph belongs to Layer 0 and carries a BODY_HIDDEN hidden span as well. It should be translated without the hidden marker, and it should not appear twice.

기대 : BODY_HIDDEN 이 없고 같은 문장이 두 번 나오지 않아야 한다
